basis: each sheet's own name and header row, read from the workbook

sheets.B - sample info: species, specimen and locality for sequenced samples
sheets.D - heterozygosity: heterozygous and fixed species-specific SNPs per species
sheets.E - CNV: average exon copy number and predicted duplicate genes per species
enrichment for relative evolutionary rate, gliding vs other beloniforms
convergent amino-acid substitutions (gene, SNP, species columns, fin-screen and fin/limb GO flags)
sheets.H - fin and limb genes: fin and limb candidate genes with average coverage
sheets.I - Glider RER genes: per-gene relative-evolutionary-rate rho, p and q for gliders
sheets.J - Exocoeidae phylop: per-gene phyloP acceleration or conservation (cons/acc) with p for the Exocoetidae
GO terms for accelerated conserved noncoding elements, Exocoetidae
GO terms for constrained CNEs, Exocoetidae
sheets.M - accel CNEs halfbeak: GO terms for accelerated CNEs, halfbeaks
sheets.N - con CNEs halfbeak: GO terms for constrained CNEs, halfbeaks

supersedes_for_descriptions: daane2021_pins.json supplement.items['Data S1C-S1N'], whose per-letter descriptions were guessed from how the main text cites them and are partly wrong (E is copy number, not contigs; J is per-gene phyloP, K-N are the CNE tables). daane2021_pins.json is left unchanged as the record of that earlier state.
